$comment: The church's email sections for Rock's newer email editor, which staff drag into an email (README.md, email-sections.json, decision 301). 'category' is a Rock.Model.EmailSection category's key in configuration/categories.json. Each section is a title, text, and a button, with an optional eyebrow line above the title and an optional photo of an approved calendar event (photos/events/manifest.json). 'card' gives the section a background: 'light' is the template's page color and 'accent' its accent color, from the template's Lava fields in configuration/communications.json. A section with 'serviceTimes' lists each of the dataset's campuses with its Sunday service times, filled in at load. email-sections/make-sections.js builds each section's markup with Rock's own email editor code, and its thumbnail, into email-sections/.

sections.name: Service Times
sections.usageSummary: A card with the Sunday service times at every campus and a button to plan a visit. Use it in a welcome or holiday email.
sections.title: Service times
sections.text: Every service has the same message, kids rooms for every age, and a welcome tent by the front doors.

sections.name: Upcoming Event
sections.usageSummary: An event photo, title, and short description with a sign-up button. Swap in the event you are promoting.
sections.title: Parents' Night Out
sections.text: Drop off the kids for pizza, games, and a movie, and go have a night to yourselves. Spots are limited, so sign up early.

sections.name: Give Online
sections.usageSummary: A teal card that invites people to give online, with a Give button. Use it near the end of an email.
sections.title: Give online
sections.text: Thank you for giving. Your generosity helps people take a next step at every campus. Give once, or set up a recurring gift in a few minutes.

sections.name: Built on the Rock Update
sections.usageSummary: The campaign's artwork, a short update, and a button to the campaign page. Use it in a Built on the Rock update.
sections.title: Building on a foundation that lasts
sections.text: Thank you for building with us. Every gift moves us closer to a Student Center at the Phoenix campus and new kids rooms at every campus.
